beatbox.screen.setup.title: Before the first machine
beatbox.screen.setup.blurb: What BeatBox needs from this computer, and whether it is here. Anything missing that BeatBox can put in place itself has a button; the system asks for your password or approval, never BeatBox.
beatbox.setup.working: Working on it — if the system asks for your password or approval, that is this.
beatbox.setup.after.restart: Done. It takes effect once Windows restarts.
beatbox.setup.qemu.missing: QEMU is not installed, and machines need it. BeatBox can install it; as administrator it runs: {command}
beatbox.setup.qemu.no_window: QEMU cannot open a window. BeatBox can add it; as administrator it runs: {command}
beatbox.setup.qemu.by_hand: QEMU is missing or cannot open a window. Run this as administrator: {command}
beatbox.setup.qemu.unknown_system: QEMU is missing or cannot open a window. Install qemu-system-x86_64, qemu-img, QEMU's GTK display and OVMF with your package manager.
beatbox.setup.qemu.winget: QEMU is not installed, and machines need it. BeatBox can install it with winget; Windows will ask first.
beatbox.setup.qemu.download: QEMU is not installed. Download it from {url}, install it, then check again.
beatbox.setup.acceleration.kvm_group: {user} cannot open /dev/kvm, so machines run about ten times slower. BeatBox can add {user} to the kvm group; it works after you log in again.
beatbox.setup.acceleration.relogin: You are in the kvm group now. Close BeatBox, log out and back in.
beatbox.setup.acceleration.whpx: The Windows Hypervisor Platform is off, so machines run about ten times slower. BeatBox can turn it on; Windows asks first, then restart.
beatbox.setup.guest_tools.ready: Version {version}, plugged into every Windows machine as a USB drive.
beatbox.setup.guest_tools.missing: Drivers and agent for Windows machines. {megabytes} MB, downloaded once.
beatbox.setup.dismissed: The password dialog was closed, so nothing was changed.
beatbox.setup.declined: Nothing was installed: Windows did not get a Yes. Press the button again and answer Yes (look for a flashing shield on the taskbar).
beatbox.setup.preview_note: Preview: what someone missing everything would see. Nothing is installed, and nothing on this computer is read or changed.
